policy: Historical records are retained for auditability but excluded from the real-service denominator when they are composite labels or guidance rather than one government transaction.

decisions.reason: Initial approval remains a recognisable government setup transaction, but the former deep link redirects to an unusable generic directory. The page remains live with a disabled CTA.
The historical label combines trade-name reservation, initial approval and licence issuance.
Travel agency and tour operator are regulated economic activities, not one DET transaction. The record now guides users to activity-code search and licence issuance.
Event permits and individual tour-guide licensing are separate official services with different audiences, documents and destinations.
